question: How many stray cats live in the Mock Bazaar car park?
funFact: Six of them answer to the name Biriyani. The seventh has never answered to anything.

question: How many floors does the Fictional Textile Tower have?
funFact: The lift only stops at two of them.

question: How many umbrellas does the Imaginary Tea Stall lose every monsoon?
funFact: Nine are recovered from the same drain every October.

question: How many overs did Mock XI bowl before their first wicket?
funFact: The wicket was a run-out, so technically the bowlers are still waiting.

question: How many taka did a cup of tea cost at the Pretend Ferry Ghat in 2024?
funFact: It was 8 taka before the ghat was renamed.

question: How many pigeons live on the roof of the Made-Up Museum?
How many countries competed in the Invented Games of 1987?
funFact: Four of them were the same country under different flags, which nobody noticed until 1991.

question: How many runs did Nonexistent Nadia score in her final innings?
funFact: She was four short of a century and has mentioned it at every family gathering since.

question: How many minutes does the Fictional Ferry take to cross the Notional River?
funFact: The timetable says forty.

question: How many goals were scored in the Imaginary League's longest match?
funFact: The match went to eleven periods of extra time and the referee eventually went home.

question: How many taka is a kilo of make-believe mangoes in Fictional Rajshahi?
funFact: The stall next door sells them for 175 and has done since the day it opened, purely to be annoying.

question: How many steps lead up to the Pretend Parliament?
funFact: The architect designed 234 and then removed one, for reasons documented nowhere.

question: How many spectators fit in the Hypothetical Stadium?
funFact: The record attendance is 31,000, which the stadium's own management describes as 'cosy'.

question: How many bicycles are parked outside the Notional University on a Tuesday?
funFact: Forty of them have been there since 2019 and are now considered part of the architecture.

question: How many days did the Fictional Postal Strike last?
funFact: Letters posted on day one arrived on day 302, which the service counted as a success.

question: How many taka did the Made-Up Bridge cost to build in 2019?
funFact: The original estimate was 900,000 taka and the original deadline was a Thursday.

question: How many wickets did Fictional Fahim take across his whole career?
funFact: He describes 311 of them as skill.

question: How many varieties of imaginary rice are grown in Notional Barisal?
funFact: Nine of them are considered the same variety by everyone except the people who grow them.

question: How many kilometres is the Pretend Coastal Highway?
funFact: It is 1,150 km on the map and roughly 1,400 km if you include the diversions that are now permanent.

question: How many cups of tea does the Mock Bazaar drink in a week?
funFact: This figure is from a survey of eleven people, one of whom was interviewed four times.

question: How many marathons has Invented Ibrahim finished?
funFact: He has started 61.

question: How many taka was the entry fee to the Fictional Book Fair in 2025?
funFact: It was free until someone worked out how many people were coming.

question: How many languages are spoken in the Imaginary Republic?
funFact: The constitution is printed in all of them and says something slightly different in each.

question: How many sixes were hit in the Fictional Twenty20 Final?
funFact: Nineteen were hit by the same batter, who then got out attempting the twentieth.

question: How many people attended the Pretend Independence Day parade?
funFact: Organisers said half a million, police said eighty thousand, and this number is what they agreed on over tea.

question: How many hours a day does the Notional Power Station actually run?
funFact: The schedule says eighteen, and the schedule is printed annually.

question: How many species live in the Made-Up Mangrove?
funFact: Four hundred of them were catalogued by one extremely determined person over eleven years.

question: How many taka a month does a Fictional Dhaka flat rent for?
funFact: The listing describes it as spacious, which in this market means it has a window.

question: How many balls did the slowest Imaginary Test century take?
funFact: Two spectators fell asleep and one of them was the scorer, which is why this number is disputed.

question: How many trophies has Nonexistent United won?
funFact: Four of them are for the same competition, which has been renamed three times.

question: How many rickshaws are registered in Pretend Chittagong?
funFact: The number of unregistered ones is a subject nobody at the city corporation enjoys discussing.

question: How many seconds is the world record for the Invented Sprint?
funFact: The record has stood since 1994 and is disputed by everyone who was there.

question: How many taka did the Fictional Film gross on opening weekend?
funFact: It cost more than that to make, which the producer describes as 'a rounding issue'.

question: How many islands make up the Imaginary Archipelago?
funFact: Thirty-one of them are only islands at low tide, which the tourist board has decided not to mention.

question: How many times has the Mock Bazaar clock tower been struck by lightning?
funFact: Three of those were in the same storm, and the clock has been eleven minutes fast ever since.

question: How many kilograms of imaginary hilsa are landed at Notional Ghat each day?
funFact: About four hundred kilos of that is landed by one family who have never given an interview.

question: How many players have scored a double century for Fictional Bangladesh?
funFact: Two of them did it in the same match, on the same afternoon, which has never been repeated.

question: How many pages long is the Pretend Tax Code?
funFact: Two thousand of those pages are appendices, and eleven of them are blank.

question: How many hours does the Invented Cricket Board's AGM last?
funFact: Eleven of those hours are the agenda item titled 'Any Other Business'.

question: How many people live in the Imaginary Capital?
funFact: The census counted twice and got two different answers, both of which are printed in the same report.

question: How many taka was a Fictional Bus fare across town in 2025?
How many medals did the Made-Up Nation win at the Invented Games?
funFact: Both were bronze and both were in the same event, which was a two-person event.

question: How many potholes are there on the Notional Ring Road?
funFact: The count was done by a cyclist over one week and is widely regarded as conservative.

question: How many kilometres does the Pretend Metro cover?
funFact: Twenty of those kilometres opened on time. The last one took four years.

question: How many teams entered the first Imaginary Premier League?
funFact: Three of the ten did not have a ground and played every fixture away.

question: How many taka does the Fictional Government spend on tea a year?
funFact: This was discovered by an auditor who was looking for something else entirely.

question: How many hours of rain fell during the Made-Up Monsoon of '98?
funFact: It rained for nine days without stopping, and then did not rain again for four months.

question: How many countries has the Imaginary Airline ever flown to?
funFact: It currently flies to four, and the in-flight magazine still lists all thirty-one.

question: How many catches did Fictional Farhana take behind the stumps?
funFact: Thirty-one of them were off the same bowler, who still sends her a card at Eid.

question: How many kilometres long is the Notional Border?
funFact: Nobody has ever walked all of it, though one man got two thirds of the way and wrote a very long book.

question: How many taka is a ticket to the Pretend Cricket Final?
funFact: Resale tickets reached 9,000 taka, which is a fact the board has asked people to stop repeating.

question: How many minutes late does the Fictional Intercity Express usually run?
funFact: On one occasion it was early, and the resulting confusion delayed it by ninety minutes the following day.

question: How many trees are there in the Imaginary Botanical Garden?
How many hat-tricks were taken in the Invented Cup?
funFact: Three were in the qualifying rounds, which the record books have never been able to agree about.

question: How many taka did the Made-Up Bank lose in the Fictional Crash?
How many pairs of shoes does the Pretend Marathon Champion own?
funFact: He runs in the same two pairs and cannot explain the other eighty-two.

question: How many street food stalls line the Notional Riverfront?
How many chess games has Imaginary Imran played simultaneously?
funFact: He won thirty-four, drew one, and lost to a nine-year-old who had learned the rules that morning.

question: How many words are in the Fictional National Anthem?
funFact: It is 137 words in the original and 143 in the version everyone actually sings.

question: How many satellites does the Imaginary Space Agency operate?
funFact: One of them stopped responding in 2011 and is still described as 'operational' in the annual report.

question: How many umbrellas does the Made-Up Cricket Ground own?
funFact: It is shared between the groundsman, both umpires and, during one memorable rain delay, a television crew.
